description: This file contains functions and types related to model selection, including resolving model references, fuzzy matching, and creating model selection state, primarily for an AI or language model system.

classes.name: ModelDirectiveSelection
classes.description: Type representing a model selection directive with provider, model, default status, and optional alias.

classes.name: ModelCatalog
classes.description: Type alias for an array of ModelCatalogEntry objects.

classes.name: ModelSelectionState
classes.description: Type representing the state of model selection, including provider, model, allowed keys, catalog, and resolution functions.

classes.name: StoredModelOverride
classes.description: Type representing a stored override for a model, including optional provider, model, and source ('session' or 'parent').

methods.name: shouldLogModelSelectionTiming
methods.description: Checks environment variable to determine if model selection timing should be logged.

methods.name: loadModelCatalogRuntime
methods.description: Lazily imports and returns the model catalog runtime module.

methods.name: loadSessionStoreRuntime
methods.description: Lazily imports and returns the session store runtime module.

methods.name: boundedLevenshteinDistance
methods.description: Calculates the Levenshtein distance between two strings with an early exit if distance exceeds maxDistance.

methods.name: resolveParentSessionKeyCandidate
methods.description: Determines the parent session key from explicit or derived values.

methods.name: resolveStoredModelOverride
methods.description: Resolves a model override from session entry or parent session, considering persisted references.

methods.name: scoreFuzzyMatch
methods.description: Scores how well a fragment matches a provider/model, considering aliases and variants.

methods.name: createModelSelectionState
methods.description: Creates and resolves the state for model selection, including catalog loading, override application, and fuzzy matching.

methods.name: resolveModelDirectiveSelection
methods.description: Resolves a model directive string into a provider and model, with fuzzy matching and validation.

methods.name: resolveContextTokens
methods.description: Determines the number of context tokens for a given provider and model, with fallback defaults.
